messages:
auditor_j.jones: Hi team — for SOC 2 scope we need the exact retention windows and sampling policy for API auth/audit logs, plus a reproducible playbook for the 2024-11-02 auth-latency incident and an example billing attribution mismatch. Can you point me to the exported manifests and KMS key details used to encrypt those exports?

maria_support: @auditor_j.jones pinged infra for the manifests. Quick answers: retention = 90 days for full audit logs, 365 days for aggregated billing metrics. Sampling policy for support exports is 1% by default, can be configured per-org.

sam_platform: Adding context — exports we hand to auditors are S3 manifests stored in the evidence bucket with presigned links and a separate manifest for chain-of-custody. Example manifest: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/exports/2145123456-manifest.csv (signed, TTL 72h).

irene_security: KMS details: exports are envelope-encrypted with alias `alias/redwood-evidence-exports`. Key rotation window: customer keys auto-rotate every 365 days; root CMK rotation on 2024-08-10. For this export the key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-2145. We keep rotation logs in keystore-audit trail.

elijah_ops: For the auth-latency repro: reproduce using the test token that hits the legacy token-verifier shard under high-concurrency. Steps I used during the incident:
```
# repro (do not run on prod without ops sign-off)
export TEST_TOKEN=<sample-token-2145>
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate &
done
```
This reproduces the elevated 503/latency pattern we saw when the KV cache warmed slowly.

kevin_engineer: Additional detail: to reproduce the billing mismatch we used a synthetic job that hit fallback routing (hosted -> dedicated fallback) and double-counted tokens in our billing pipeline when the router emitted duplicate ack events for retries. Repro steps: issue same request with `X-Request-ID` reused across retry loop, then inspect `billing.events` where `ack_count > 1`.

maria_support: Links to exports for your review (short lived):
- auth-latency incident export: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incident-2145123456-authlatency-export.csv (ttl 72h)
- billing-attribution export: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incident-2145123456-billing-export.csv (ttl 72h)
Manifest checksum: sha256: 3b7a9f...

sam_platform: Sampling config snippet from infra config (read-only):
```
export.sampling.policy={
  "window_days": 7,
  "default_rate": 0.01,
  "priority_rules": [
    {"filter": "incidents:high", "rate": 1.0},
    {"filter": "customer:enterprise", "rate": 0.1}
  ]
}
```

irene_security: Chain-of-custody steps we attach to each export: 1) export job created (hash recorded), 2) KMS envelope key metadata snapshot, 3) presigned URL generation audit, 4) download log link. We provide a PDF chain-of-custody for the auth-latency export.

auditor_j.jones: Thanks — can you confirm which control IDs these artifacts map to (SOC2)? auditor wants the mapping table and a sample assertion for CC6/CC7 (access monitoring + logging).

maria_support: We map as follows:
- API auth logs -> CC6.1 (access monitoring)
- Export manifest + chain-of-custody -> CC7.2 (system activity logging)
- KMS rotation evidence -> CC5.x (cryptographic key management)
We will attach the mapping table and sample narrative.

kevin_engineer: One more note: the billing export contains an event with id `evt-2145-dup-01` showing duplicate ack timestamps. I've added an explanation comment in the manifest for auditors.

deploy-bot: deploy success: evidence-exporter v3.4.1 -> prod at 2024-11-03T03:12:45Z (build 3.4.1-2145) :white_check_mark:

irene_security: I'll upload the mapping table + sample assertion PDF to the evidence bucket and post a short TTL link here by EOD. If you need raw keystore snapshots, we require an IR request (sensitive).

auditor_j.jones: That works. One last ask — for the auth-latency replay, include the exact shard ids and team runbook snippet you used so we can follow the same path in the playback.

elijah_ops: Shard ids used: token-verifier-8a, token-verifier-8b. Runbook snippet (sanitized):
1) set test load as above
2) tail `/var/log/token-verifier/*.log` for `KV cache miss`
3) capture flame graphs from pprof at 30s intervals
4) snapshot `redis-kv` keys for the test token
I'll attach the runbook section to the export manifest.

auditor_j.jones: Perfect — thanks everyone, will review and follow up with any clarifying Qs.
